projects.title: Effect of zinc oxide nanoparticles on water vapour permeability and mechanical properties of orange peel pectin films
projects.description:
Supervisors: Dr. Hugo Mujica and Dr. Aurora Valdez
Group of Emerging Technologies, Tecnologico de Monterrey, Summer 2015

My responsabilities within the project were to plan and conduct the experiments in which water vapour permeability, ultimate tensile strength and Young's Modulus were calculated experimentally. Two abstracts were submitted and accepted at the 29th EFFoST International Conference in Athens, Greece, and were presented in poster form by members of the group.
